figurative_meaning_bn: অপূর্ণ ঘুম; ঘুমের ঘোর কাটেনি এমন অবস্থা
figurative_meaning_en: Incomplete sleep; a state where the drowsiness or sleep haze has not yet cleared
example_sentences_in_bangla: সকালে উঠে তার কাঁচা ঘুম এখনও কাটেনি, তাই সে কিছু বুঝতে পারছে না।
কাঁচা ঘুমে সে বিছানা থেকে উঠল, কিন্তু চোখ দুটো জড়ানো।
example_sentences_in_english: He woke up early, but his raw sleep hasn't worn off yet, so he can't understand anything.
In his groggy state, he got out of bed, but his eyes were still heavy.
note: This idiom reflects the common experience of interrupted or light sleep in Bengali household contexts.
